title: ר' ירמי' בר אבא

paragraphs: R. Yirmeyah bar Abba was Rav's student-colleague. Therefore he said to Rav, 'Have you separated [from labor]?' and did not say, 'Has the master separated?' Chapter Tefillat HaShaḥar (27a as printed; the exchange is on 27b), and chapter 3 of Eruvin (40b). In chapter Arvei Pesaḥim (106, end of side b), he visited Rav Assi's house. Tosafot writes that he was Rav Huna's student, as in Kiddushin (46, beginning of side a), where Ulla says of Rav Huna's words that they are as hard as vinegar, while the words of the student, R. Yirmeyah bar Abba, seem correct. Although R. Yirmeyah bar Abba was Rav's student-colleague, as above, in Berakhot most copies read 'Rav Yirmeyah,' while in Kiddushin it reads 'R. Yirmeyah.' End of quotation. In Tosafot, Kiddushin there, they write: it appears there were two Rav Yirmeyahs. In Jerusalem Talmud, Ketubbot, chapter 1, halakhah 10: R. Yirmeyah bar Va, R. Yose (that is, R. Assi). His father Abba was a great penitent (see his entry). R. Abba addressed him as 'master,' Ḥullin (57a). R. Abba said: R. Yirmeyah bar Abba said. R. Avina, in his name. He asked Rav Assi. R. Yirmeyah bar Abba said: 'I fixed it with Giddel' (I taught it to Giddel), 'and Giddel fixed it with Yehudah' (he taught it to Rav Yehudah), Bekhorot (36b). Rav Huna, his teacher (see above). Rav Huna, his son. Rav Huna bar Ḥiyya, his son-in-law, spoke in his name. R. Zeira said: R. Yirmeyah bar Abba said, chapter Ḥezkat HaBattim (47b). R. Zeira said, 'It was explained to me personally by R. Yirmeyah bar Abba,' Ta'anit (12b). He, Rav Ḥanan bar Abba, and Rav Yehudah were at the house of R. Avin Nashkaya. Rav Ḥisda said: R. Yirmeyah bar Abba said, chapter HaRo'eh (55b), Ḥelek (103a), Ta'anit (12b). Rav Yehudah, in his name, Shabbat (150a), Gittin (35a). It is uncertain whether he cited Shemuel [the passage also names Rav as the alternative], Bekhorot (36b). He said, 'R. Yoḥanan said,' Niddah (23b). R. Yirmeyah bar Taḥlifa (see his entry). Levi bar Huna bar Ḥiyya, his grandson. Rav Naḥman sent to him at Shum Tamya—that is, a place—Bava Batra (153a). He said, 'Rav said,' chapter Ein Tzadin (29, end of side a), Megillah (18b). 'I asked my teacher'—who was that? Rav—chapter Kol Sha'ah (37a), Beitzah (22b). Rabbah bar Taḥlifa said: R. Yirmeyah bar Abba said. Rava said: R. Yirmeyah bar Abba said: Rav said, chapter HaRo'eh (56a), Ketubbot (60a). Rav Sheshet, in his name; Rav Sheshet said to him, “Did Rav teach this in accordance with the Kutim?” [The checked Niddah 69a reads ככותאי. Heilprin’s witness has כוותאי, “in accordance with my view.”]
